title: telemetry events: import env_pack lazily inside parse() and env_pack functions to avoid an events -> env_pack -> models.model import cycle
answers: Why does importing mlflow.telemetry.events fail with a circular import after adding a new event?
Where does RegisterModelEvent get the EnvPackType values without causing an import cycle?
How do I add a telemetry event that depends on a model or utils module without breaking imports?
body:
Path: mlflow/telemetry/events.py:RegisterModelEvent.parse needs mlflow/utils/env_pack.py:EnvPackType to validate the env_pack value. env_pack imports models code, and models code imports telemetry events, so a top-level import would close a cycle.
Rule: Put imports that reach mlflow.utils.env_pack or mlflow.models inside the function that needs them (for example the first line of RegisterModelEvent.parse and the telemetry import inside mlflow/utils/env_pack.py:pack_env_for_databricks_model_serving). Keep module-level imports in events.py limited to the modules that do not create the cycle.
Symptom: Adding a top-level import of env_pack into events.py causes import errors at package import time, before any telemetry call runs.
Constraints: Lazy imports add a small cost on each call, which is acceptable for telemetry parse paths. mlflow/models/model.py imports LogModelEvent at module level without issue because events.py does not import models.
applies: Edits to mlflow/telemetry/events.py or mlflow/utils/env_pack.py that add imports between telemetry and model or utils modules.
says: Importing the machine learning package fails on startup with a circular dependency error.
Registering a trained model crashes immediately when validating model serving environments.
Model registry tools fail to load because of an initialization loop in telemetry.
Ensure model packaging and registry operations can be imported without startup crashes.
search: Telemetry events avoid circular imports by importing mlflow.utils.env_pack and mlflow.models lazily inside functions like RegisterModelEvent.parse and pack_env_for_databricks_model_serving instead of at module level. This applies to edits in mlflow/telemetry/events.py and mlflow/utils/env_pack.py where RegisterModelEvent.parse needs EnvPackType to validate env_pack, but env_pack imports models which imports telemetry events. Module-level imports in events.py must avoid closing the cycle, lazy imports incur an acceptable per-call cost, and mlflow/models/model.py may import LogModelEvent at module level because events.py does not import models.
